identity: ONE original four-legged magma wyrm, the Deepforge Vaultwyrm, facing screen LEFT in elevated three-quarter view. Keep the overlapping bronze and dark stone armour plates with glowing orange-red lava cracks between them, the long crocodile-like jaws lined with teeth and glowing inside, the ridge of short plated spines along the back, the segmented tail curling up high behind the body to a bulbous plated tip, and EXACTLY FOUR thick armoured legs with glowing orange claws. No rider and no extra legs. Preserve the plates and lava cracks, the jaws, the curled tail and the stocky proportions.
plate: Locked orthographic camera, fixed scale and centred body. Keep the jaws, the whole curled tail and all four feet within frame. The background is perfectly flat saturated BLUE throughout, no gradients or changes of hue. The blue background stays the same flat saturated blue in every frame and never darkens, flashes or changes colour. No scenery, floor shadow, camera motion, zoom, flames, smoke, embers, sparks, dripping lava, motion trails, particles or extra legs; the lava cracks, jaws and claws keep only their steady glow. Articulate joints naturally with physical planted-foot support; the armour plates stay rigid and never morph.

idle_h3_v1.action: A smouldering, watchful idle that loops. The wyrm breathes slowly so the plates rise and settle, the head lowers and lifts slightly, the jaws part a little and close, the curled tail flexes, then everything returns smoothly to the original stance. All four feet stay planted. No walking and no attack.

move_h3_v1.action: Crawl in place on four legs through two complete cycles with heavy sprawling steps. Diagonal pairs of legs alternate lifting, swinging forward and planting their clawed feet while the others bear the weight, the body flexing slightly. The body stays centred for engine-driven travel, still facing screen left, with the head low and the tail curled. Exactly four legs at all times. Finish in the original gait phase.

attack_h3_v1.action: Make ONE lunging bite toward screen left. The wyrm rears its head and forequarters up with the jaws gaping wide, then drives forward and down toward screen left and snaps the jaws shut at full reach, then draws back and settles into the original stance. One bite only; no fire, embers or effect.

hit_h3_v1.action: One heavy recoil and complete recovery. The wyrm rears up and back toward screen right with the head thrown high and the jaws open, the front legs lifting slightly, then drops back onto all four feet and returns to the same stance. Nothing is seen hitting it: no projectile, spark or flash. The blue background never flashes or changes colour.

defend_h3_v1.action: Hunker down: the wyrm lowers its belly and head close to the ground, hunches the armoured back so the plates overlap like a shell, curls the tail in and braces all four legs, then holds the low armoured crouch. No attack and no return to the standing stance.

cast_h3_v1.action: A forge roar. The wyrm rears up on its hind legs with the head raised high and the jaws open wide as if roaring, the lava cracks glowing a little brighter, holds the pose briefly, then drops back onto all four feet in the original stance. Only the cracks brighten; no fire, embers or spell effect.

death_h3_v1.action: Collapse slowly and heavily. The lava cracks dim, the legs buckle and the wyrm sinks down onto its belly with the head lowering, stays a moment, then slumps flat with the jaws closed and resting on the ground at screen left and the tail lying stretched out to screen right, finishing motionless and cooled dark. The same body throughout: no explosion, no fire and no disappearing.
